title: LoVeC: Reinforcement Learning for Better Verbalized Confidence in Long-Form Generation
research_question: Can reinforcement learning teach language models to emit sentence-level numerical confidence during long-form generation that is better calibrated to factual correctness and more efficient than post-hoc sampling methods?
methodology: LoVeC trains Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Gemma-2-9B-It to associate generated factual statements with numerical sentence-level confidence scores. The authors formulate confidence generation as a sequential decision problem and compare SFT with on-policy GRPO and off-policy preference training through DPO, using evidence-based fact checking to construct rewards or preference pairs. Evaluation uses free-form and iterative tagging on WildHallu, Bios, and long-form PopQA, with Brier Score, soft-label ECE-M, and Spearman correlation between confidence and factuality. GPT-4o with retrieved evidence supplies the principal factuality labels, with an additional human reliability study, and the paper also measures runtime, cross-domain transfer, short-form QA transfer, and reward-hacking diagnostics.

key_findings.finding: RL-trained LoVeC models consistently improved sentence-level confidence calibration over prompting, SFT, self-consistency, and the LUQ baseline across the reported long-form datasets.
For Llama-3 iterative tagging on WildHallu, LoVeC-GRPO reached a Brier Score of 5.7, ECE-M of 2.5, and Spearman correlation of 57.0, improving substantially over the SFT initialization.
Calibration improvements transferred from WildHallu training to the out-of-domain Bios and PopQA evaluations.
Inline confidence prediction was reported to process the WildHallu test set about 20 times faster than the sampling-based LUQ method in the stated Gemma-2-9B single-A100 comparison.

The RL objective can improve calibration without requiring the model to avoid every hallucination, because hallucinated statements are acceptable to the objective if they receive appropriately low confidence.

Human checking of a 312-sentence sample showed high inter-annotator agreement, supporting the use of evidence-conditioned GPT-4o as the main factuality estimator, although it does not make that estimator error-free.

The authors found no evidence of obvious reward hacking under their diagnostics for output length, factuality, semantic diversity, vocabulary richness, repetition, prompt copying, or template collapse.

limitations: The training method requires access to white-box model parameters and therefore does not directly apply to closed black-box models.
The experiments focus specifically on factuality confidence rather than completeness, citation support, relevance, usefulness, or other dimensions of long-form quality.
The main factuality target is supplied by an LLM fact-checker conditioned on retrieved evidence, so training and evaluation inherit errors from that verifier and its evidence.
The reported out-of-domain generalization covers Bios and PopQA but does not establish robustness to arbitrary distribution shifts.
The study does not explicitly evaluate temporal drift, evidence version changes, or confidence calibration after the underlying facts change.
High-stakes domains such as law, healthcare, and finance are proposed as future work rather than evaluated settings.
Sentence-level confidence can hide mixed correctness among multiple atomic claims contained in one sentence.
raw_claims: LoVeC attaches numerical confidence scores to factual statements in long-form generation.
The method trains confidence behavior with reinforcement-learning objectives rather than relying only on supervised fine-tuning.
WildHallu is used for training and evaluation while Bios and PopQA are used as out-of-domain test sets.
Brier Score, ECE-M, and Spearman correlation are the main confidence-calibration metrics.
GRPO and DPO generally outperform SFT and the evaluated confidence baselines.
The WildHallu runtime comparison reports roughly a twenty-fold speed advantage over LUQ.
GPT-4o with retrieved evidence is used as the primary factuality verifier.
A human study checks the reliability of the automated factuality annotations.
The released implementation links to public code and the external datasets used by the experiments.
